title: フロンティア・スピリッツ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During an interview with Etsuko Otonashi, Taiki Shuttle talks about her ambition to become Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to hide her shock, the reporter informs Taiki that there has never been a single sprinter selected for the title.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle is up against an unprecedented challenge… but sees it a trivial concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She explains her solution with vigor—if there's never been a sprinter selected as Umamusume of the Year, she'll just have to be the first!
